svg.title: France: the adjustment that would stabilise the debt (S2 indicator) and its two components
svg.desc: Permanent adjustment of the structural primary balance, from 2027, that would stabilise the debt over an infinite horizon, in points of GDP, split between the initial budgetary position and the effect of future changes in age-related spending, according to the European Commission (Debt Sustainability Monitor 2025), in three scenarios and in the previous edition. Baseline scenario: S2 3.1, of which initial position 3.0 and effect of future changes in age-related spending 0.1. Lower productivity: S2 3.8, of which initial position 3.3 and effect of future changes in age-related spending 0.5. Health and long-term care risk: S2 5.4, of which initial position 3.0 and effect of future changes in age-related spending 2.4. Previous edition (2024): S2 3.4, of which initial position 3.3 and effect of future changes in age-related spending 0.1.
svg.text: France: the adjustment that would stabilise the debt (S2 indicator) and its two components
initial budgetary position (current spending included, pensions too)
effect of future changes in age-related spending
European Commission, Debt Sustainability Monitor 2025, country tables: S2 indicator and its two components, France
Current pension spending is in the initial position; the second term measures only the projected change in age-related
spending. The previous edition is another set of projections, not an observed change. Projections conditional on the
Commission's assumptions (2024 Ageing Report, 2023 pension reform applied).
